**Current**
- Adams is Houston's backup center behind Alperen Sengun. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1462), [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=1091))
- Lloyd sees him only as a rebound streamer for certain matchups. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1462))
- He is healthy now. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1894))
- Lloyd expects him to sit back-to-backs, definitely at the start of the season. (verdict, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1894))
- Coach Ime Udoka plays his starters very heavy minutes, which limits bench minutes. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=146), [09-09](https://youtu.be/7BllEsdNLoM?t=2451))
- The Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs this season, which limits the number of games he is likely to rest. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=2011))
- With our March 28 end date, Houston has a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over weeks 19 to 21. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1970))
- He missed a large part of last season. (fact, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1015))
- Houston is expected to use double-big lineups with Adams and Sengun at times. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1015))
- Houston is projected to win 54 games. The team is expected to be conservative in the regular season and not chase seeding. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=1780))
- With Adams back, Jabari Smith Jr. plays more power forward than center. Adams is part of a crowded bench with Marcus Smart, Reed Sheppard and Bogdan Bogdanovic. (fact, 2026-07-14; [07-14](https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE?t=1091))

**Durable**
- He makes no threes and scores very few points, both far below the league pool. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- Adams has persistent knee problems. (fact, 2026-10-01; [10-01](https://youtu.be/aLP080hxizA?t=1894))
- He is arguably the greatest offensive rebounder in NBA history and often needs two or three bodies to keep him off the glass. (verdict, 2026-08-12; [08-12](https://youtu.be/yoCTTlJ_tPQ?t=962))

**Tags**
- Current: `back-to-back risk` (Lloyd expects him to sit back-to-backs, definitely at the start of the season), `questionable` (Yahoo status Q (Rest)), `injury last season` (missed a large part of 2025-26), `waiver watch` (rebound streamer for certain matchups), `few back-to-backs` (Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs), `bad playoff schedule` (3-3-4, 10 games in weeks 19 to 21 with the March 28 end), `winning team` (projected 54 wins)
- Durable: `no 3PM` (0.0 threes per game in every season and projection), `injury prone` (persistent knee problems), `heavy starter minutes` (Udoka plays starters heavy minutes, which caps a backup center), `defense-first` (Ime Udoka cares mostly about defense and runs a basic offense)

**Note.** Adams is not a draft pick in our 144-player auction. Both sites value him at 0 USD, with ranks of 397 on Yahoo and 329 on ESPN, and he gives nothing in threes or points. His only use is as a short-term waiver add for rebounds in good matchups. He had 8.6 rebounds in 22.8 minutes last season, but he is a backup now and should sit back-to-backs. Early in the season, check whether Udoka really plays him next to Sengun in double-big lineups and how often he rests.
